MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
          |
          |-- injected services
          |   |-- DiagramService                   immutable content revisions -> [G]
          |   `-- CanvasHistoryService             canvas contexts and checkpoints -> [E]
          |
          |-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace
          |   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft   metadata + stable session handle
          |   |   |-- representationId? / name / revisionId / busy
          |   |   |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges / hidden?
          |   |   |-- viewport? / focusBox?
          |   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
          |   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController
          |   |       |-- document                 semantic document store
          |   |       |-- presentation             display / diagramViews
          |   |       |-- selection                SelectionState.items[]
          |   |       |-- controls / geometry / status
          |   |       `-- onCommit()               notify workspace persistence
          |   |-- controllers[documentId]          index of session-owned controllers
          |   `-- owns session creation, subscriptions and disposal
          |
          |-- MappingDocumentController
          |   |-- diagrams: DiagramService         content edits -> [G]
          |   |-- historyService: CanvasHistoryService
          |   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext    opaque history handle
          |   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
          |   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
          |   |   |-- canUndo / canRedo             historyService.state(context)
          |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
          |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
          |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox         grid containment + layout -> [A]
          |   |   |   |   `-- contents[id]: Diagram -> [B]
          |   |   |   `-- edges / jumps / sections
          |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
          |   |       |-- selection: SelectionState
          |   |       |   `-- items[]               unified diagram / region membership
          |   |       |-- diagramViews             per-diagram folding state
          |   |       |-- display: DisplayState    floating objects only -> [C]
          |   |       `-- controls: MappingControls
          |   |           |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
          |   |           `-- surfaces[ownerId]: SelectionSurfaceState
          |   |-- getCanvasSnapshot(): CanvasDocument
          |   |-- resolveDiagram(diagramId): DiagramView
          |   |-- exportHistory() / forkHistory()
          |   |   `-- historyService.exportContext() / forkContext()
          |   |-- undo / redo / reset
          |   |   `-- CanvasHistoryService navigation
          |   |
          |   `-- nodes(): DisplayNode[]         derived public registry
          |       |
          |       |-- DisplayNode = CanvasDisplayNode
          |       |   |-- id                     grid:... or floating:...
          |       |   |-- version                document version at read time
          |       |   |-- childIds[]
          |       |   `-- expansion              expanded | collapsed
          |       |
          |       |-- Grid branch                layout: "grid"
          |       |   |-- kind                   diagram | group
          |       |   |-- boxId                  authoritative GridBox ID
          |       |   |-- geometry
          |       |   |   |-- units              "cells"
          |       |   |   `-- bounds: GridBounds
          |       |   |       `-- column / row / columns / rows
          |       |   `-- content?: DiagramContent
          |       |
          |       `-- Floating branch            layout: "floating"
          |           |-- geometry
          |           |   |-- units              "pixels"
          |           |   |-- position { x, y }
          |           |   |-- bounds { width, height }
          |           |   `-- coordinateSpace    canvas | viewport
          |           |-- placement: FloatingPlacement
          |           |   |-- grid-region        selected source rectangle
          |           |   |-- parent             projection owner
          |           |   |-- conversation       anchor + presentation
          |           |   `-- stored             retained coordinate space
          |           `-- value: FloatingBox
          |               |-- SelectionRegion   kind: selection
          |               |-- ProjectedPane     kind: projection
          |               |-- ConversationPane  kind: conversation
          |               `-- DetailPane        kind: detail
          |
          |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(...)             agent access + controller edits -> [D]
          |
          |-- WorkspacePersistence                  incremental autosave adapter
          |   |-- CanvasWorkspace.onPersist(documentIds)
          |   |-- SourcePaneViewState changes
          |   `-- controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> RecordStorage.batch()
          |       `-- Workspace persistence flow    detailed owner-to-storage path
          |
          |-- WorkspaceStorage
          |   |-- owns RecordStorage                cached records + pending writes
          |   `-- owns workspaceStorage.worker      encoding, transport and restore
          |
          `-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot   explicit export / workspace operations
              |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId / transfers
              `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
                  |-- identity / name / saved baselines / revisionId / hidden?
                  |-- document / canvas / viewport
                  `-- history                       controller.exportHistory()
          |
          GridBoxes occupy grid space; FloatingBoxes never displace them.
